scripts.dev: concurrently -n react,electron "npm run dev:react" "wait-on http://localhost:5173 && npm run dev:electron"
scripts.build: npm run build:react && npm run build:electron && cross-env CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml
scripts.dist:win: npm run build:react && npm run build:electron && cross-env CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false electron-builder --win --config electron-builder.yml
